title: MOCK Official Notice: Advanced Accelerator Export Controls
snippet: MOCK OFFICIAL NOTICE. Controls apply only to listed advanced accelerator products meeting the specified performance threshold and destination criteria. Effective date: 2026-09-01. The notice does not impose a universal consumer electronics ban.

title: MOCK Guidance: Scope and transition period
snippet: MOCK OFFICIAL GUIDANCE reiterates the 2026-09-01 effective date and says classification depends on technical specifications. Ambiguous products should be referred to compliance counsel.

title: MOCK Notice: Advanced accelerator controls - Asia-Pacific summary
snippet: MOCK notice summary for Asia-Pacific authorities. It repeats the threshold-based scope and does not independently change the North America effective date.
